sources.locator: Title search: 成对密钥协商方案

statement.zh: **标准**：成对密钥协商方案（Pairwise Key Agreement Schemes）。摘要给出范围：「This Recommendation specifies key-establishment schemes based on the discrete logarithm problem over finite fields and elliptic curves, including several variations of Diffie-Hellman and Menezes-Qu-Vanstone (MQV) key establishment schemes.」即它管的是离散对数类协商方案的构造与使用条件。
statement.en: **Standard**: Pairwise Key Agreement Schemes (成对密钥协商方案).The abstract sets the range: "This Recommendation specifies key-establishment schemes based on the discrete logarithm problem over finite fields and elliptic curves, including several variations of Diffie-Hellman and Menezes-Qu-Vanstone (MQV) key establishment schemes." Its subject is the construction and preconditions of discrete-log key establishment.

statement.zh: 它把一类构造集中成一份可实施的规范：摘要写「This Recommendation specifies key-establishment schemes based on the discrete logarithm problem over finite fields and elliptic curves」，关键词表列出「Diffie-Hellman; elliptic curve cryptography; finite field cryptography; key agreement; key confirmation; key derivation; key establishment; MQV.」——协商、确认与派生在同一份文件里成体系。
statement.en: It gathers a family of constructions into one implementable specification: the abstract says "This Recommendation specifies key-establishment schemes based on the discrete logarithm problem over finite fields and elliptic curves", and the keyword line indexes the scope — "Diffie-Hellman; elliptic curve cryptography; finite field cryptography; key agreement; key confirmation; key derivation; key establishment; MQV." Agreement, confirmation and derivation are treated as one system.

statement.zh: 落地的是密钥建立方案的选型：文件按使用静态/临时密钥的数量给方案分档（关键词表以 MQV 收束这一族），并在 §5 给出 FFC 与 ECC 两类原语的算法步骤——目录中可见「MQV1 Form of the FFC MQV Primitive」、「Full MQV」与「One-Pass Form of the ECC MQV Primitive」。符合性测试与用语规范位于前言的 Authority 与 Conformance Testing 段落（「The requirements of this Recommendation are indicated by the word “shall.”」）。
statement.en: Its use is choosing among key-establishment schemes: the document grades schemes by how many static and ephemeral key pairs they consume (the keyword line closes the family with MQV) and §5 gives the algorithm steps for the FFC and ECC primitives — the contents list carries "MQV1 Form of the FFC MQV Primitive", "Full MQV" and "One-Pass Form of the ECC MQV Primitive".Conformance and the modality vocabulary sit in the front-matter Authority and Conformance Testing blocks: "The requirements of this Recommendation are indicated by the word “shall.

statement.zh: 限度一是适用条件的原话：这类指南「shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems」，不是无条件适用于所有联邦系统。限度二是文本边界：前言承认部分要求「may be out-of-scope for CAVP or CMVP validation testing」，其后被省略的分句才是责任归属——由使用、实现、安装或配置应用的一方承担。
statement.en: The first limit is the conditional wording: guidance of this kind "shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems" — application is not unconditional.The second is the validation boundary: the front matter concedes that some requirements "may be out-of-scope for CAVP or CMVP validation testing", and the omitted clause after that comma is the point — the responsibility falls on the entities using, implementing, installing or configuring the application.

statement.zh:
署名与版次在标题页：作者为 Elaine Barker、Lily Chen、Allen Roginsky、Apostol Vassilev、Richard Davis 五人，标题行写「NIST Special Publication 800-56A Revision 3」，DOI 指向 rev3 版；本文件自身未声明被后续修订取代。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：成对密钥协商方案的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。
statement.en: The title page gives authorship and edition: Elaine Barker, Lily Chen, Allen Roginsky, Apostol Vassilev and Richard Davis, with the heading "NIST Special Publication 800-56A Revision 3" and a DOI resolving to the rev3 file.Nothing in the document announces a later revision.
